Kismile 20-Bar Stainless Espresso Machine with Integrated Conical Burr Grinder

Kismile 20-Bar All-in-One Espresso Machine features an integrated conical burr grinder, pressure gauge, and powerful steam wand for specialty coffee in Singapore.

  • ✔ All-in-one bean-to-cup system with precision integrated stainless conical burr grinder

  • ✔ Instant hot water dispenser for Americanos, long blacks, and artisan teas
